summary: Iter 30 Wave 3 backend validation: 20/20 tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_wave3_growth_and_restore.py. Verified: (1) POST /api/admin/users/{seller_id}/restore reverses soft-delete — flips is_deleted/is_active on user, un-flags owned shop (is_public=true), restaurant (is_open=true), product (is_active=true), menu_item (is_available=true) and sets restored_at; restored user reappears on default GET /api/admin/users. (2) Restore on non-deleted user returns {ok:true, restored:false, already_active:true} (idempotent). (3) Restore is admin-only — seller/customer both get 403. (4) GET /api/seller/growth-insights returns proper shape {seller_id, shop_name, curr:{orders,revenue_usd,cancelled,favorites,rating,review_count}, prev:{...}, top_products, window}; all metric fields are numeric (int/float), and reflect seeded splits/favorites. 403 for customer, 401 anonymous. (5) POST /api/admin/growth-insights/send/{id} dry_run=true returns {ok, dry_run, metrics}; without dry_run responds 200 with {ok, email_id, seller_id} shape even when RESEND_API_KEY is missing (email_id=null, ok=false) — NOT 500. On a soft-deleted seller returns 400 'Seller is soft-deleted'. (6) POST /api/admin/growth-insights/send-all returns {ok:true, sent, skipped, failed, total_sellers}; sellers with zero activity across both windows are in skipped with reason 'no activity'; sellers with empty/invalid email are in skipped with reason 'no valid email'. (7) GET /api/search relevance ranking: exact-prefix name (Fresh Foods) > substring name (Refreshing Fresh) > description-only (Deli Zone with description='fresh imported deli goods') for q='fresh'. LTG partner tie-breaks equal-relevance rows (Alpha Bravo LTG ranks above Alpha Charlie non-LTG). Soft-deleted + is_public=false shops excluded. (8) Regression: /api/shops?ltg=true only LTG, ?verified=true only Verified, ?wholesale=true / ?deals=true respond 200; /api/homepage/featured-products returns list<=limit; soft-cascade delete still blocks login (401) + hides shop (is_deleted=true).
critical_code_review_comments: email_service._pct_delta divides by prev when prev>0 with no protection against edge case where curr and prev are the same non-zero — returns +0% which is fine, but for the 'cancels' KPI the code negates both values (line 315 in email_service.py: _pct_delta(-curr.cancelled, -prev.cancelled)) — the intent is to color a *drop* in cancellations green, but the formula (-3 - -5)/-5 = -0.4 yields '-40%' colored red for a strict improvement. Consider computing cancels delta directly and inverting the color decision instead of negating inputs.

_compute_seller_growth_metrics uses shop_docs[0]['name'] with no is_deleted filter — a seller whose newest shop was soft-deleted but has an older un-deleted shop may show the wrong shop_name; low priority.

seller_growth_insights_preview allows role='admin' — the endpoint always computes on user['id']; an admin calling it sees THEIR OWN growth (which is empty since admin owns no shops). Confusing but not broken. Consider dropping 'admin' from require_role or adding ?seller_id override for admin.

admin_send_growth_insights_all is unbounded — sequentially awaits per-seller compute+send in a single request; for 2000+ sellers this will hit request timeouts. Move to a background job / batching for scale.

global_search's ranker treats 'restaurants' and 'products' with the same key that references doc.get('verification') even though products don't carry verification — harmless (all get verified=1) but obscure; document or split rankers per collection.
